title: Cave Horror Project: Origins
description: Cave Horror Project: Origins brings you back to where it all began.
body:
**Cave Horror Project: Origins** brings you back to where it all began - the original experience that started the nightmare. This is a lightweight, raw version of Cave Horror Project, focused on atmosphere, exploration, and the constant feeling that you are not alone...
# 
Descend into shadowy caves where every sound matters.
Explore a world that feels familiar… yet deeply wrong.
And survive long enough to realize:

something is watching you.
# 
### What to expect:
- A **simpler**, more **focused horror experience** with heavier emphasis on atmosphere
- The original feeling of fear, isolation, and mystery
- A return to the roots of **Cave Horror Project**

### This is not the full experience:
This version is designed for players who want:
- The classic Cave Horror Project feel
- Better performance
- A more sandbox-style horror survival
  
If you're looking for the full storyline, quests, and expanded content, check out the main version of Cave Horror Project [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cave-horror-project-modpack).
